Dave Matthews Band

PNC Bank Arts Center - Holmdel, NJ

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 10 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: FOH, Stage Right, DFC, Mics PAS @ 10'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.81 (Gain, Mixing/Post Processing, Normalizing, Resample 32/48) > Audacity 3.3.3 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Set Time: [02:41:13.109]

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals

Notes:

⁶ with Warren Haynes on Electric Guitar

⁹ with Stefan solo intro

After Warehouse, Dave sings the first few lines of Barbara Streisand's "The Way We Were" acapella.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers that have taught me to love archiving live music.

Compiled on 2023/07/21.
